summary: Auna S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing the filing of its annual report on Form 20-F for fiscal year 2025 with the SEC. This is a routine regulatory filing by a foreign private issuer, disclosing no special situation such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or management change. The press release merely notifies investors of the availability of the audited financial statements and provides instructions for accessing the report online or requesting a hard copy. There are no deal terms, strategic actions, or corporate events to analyze.
